tools.name: search_vacancies
tools.description: Search open vacancies for seafarers on Rynda Crewing. The order is the same for every employer and does not depend on paid plans. Filter by rank, vessel type and minimum monthly salary in USD. Returns up to 20 vacancies per call with pay, contract, joining date and port, vessel, employer and the url

tools.name: get_vacancy
tools.description: Full public details of one vacancy: description, requirements (sea service, languages, certificates, visas), vessel particulars, benefits, contract and pay, the employer and how to apply. Accepts the id or the url returned by search_vacancies. A vacancy that is closed is reported as not found.

tools.name: get_salary_by_rank
tools.description: What employers offer a rank in vacancies on Rynda Crewing: median monthly pay in USD and the middle half of the range (25th to 75th percentile), each with the number of vacancies and companies behind it, the typical contract, the report period, and how many vacancies of the rank are open now. tools.name: list_ranks
tools.description: Ranks that have open vacancies on Rynda Crewing right now, how many each, with the page that lists them. Use it to answer what jobs are available or to pick a rank name for search_vacancies.
